title: The same invoice paid with native USDC on the right chain and six decimals (clean control)

proof.python:
import json
p = json.load(open('plan.json')); t = p['txs'][0]; tl = json.load(open('tokens.json'))['tokens']
x = [k for k in tl if k['address'] == t['to']][0]
assert p['chainId'] == x['chainId'] == 8453 and x['kind'].startswith('native') and int(t['args']['amount']) == 8000 * 10**x['decimals']
assert t['args']['recipient'] in [e['address'] for e in json.load(open('address_book.json'))['entries']] and t['args']['recipient'] in open('invoice.txt').read()
